_comment: Codepoints present in BOTH subsetted webfonts. Generated by the
subsetting step; see README.md. build/tools/assert-glyphs.mjs fails
the build if the site uses a character that is in neither this list
Characters the site uses that neither Jost nor Open Sans contains
at all -- verified against the upstream variable fonts, not just
the subsets. These have always been drawn by a system fallback
face, under Google Fonts exactly as they are now. They cannot be
added to the subset because there is nothing upstream to subset.

names.200A: hair space; Open Sans has it, Jost does not, and a fallback space is indistinguishable
names.2190: left arrow, used in step-back links
names.2192: right arrow, used in link affordances and the pipeline diagram
names.25D0: half-filled circle, partial support in the matrices
